schemeNotes.rpc: Control requests: one gateway command, matching request/response pairs.
schemeNotes.rpc-raw: One-shot binary reads through the same gateway and permissions, returning bytes for images or file chunks.
schemeNotes.channel-json: Structured push stream with data, end and exit envelopes.
schemeNotes.channel-in: Batched uplink to a native sink. Tauri Channels carry data in the opposite direction.
schemeNotes.channel-raw: Binary push stream with a one-byte kind followed by its payload.
schemeNotes.event-bus: Broadcast once to subscribers in all windows, without polling.
schemeNotes.stdio-line: A plugin's native Sidecar communicates over bidirectional line-delimited JSON.
schemeNotes.pty-stream: Pseudoterminal byte streams preserve terminal control sequences.
schemeNotes.in-process: Window-local events pass values by reference with no IPC.

settings.startupDescription: Whether Toolkit launches with the system. The current OS setting is read each time.
settings.updatesDescription: Toolkit checks for updates quietly at startup. Installing stops all running processes, replaces the app and restarts it.
settings.modelsDescription: Configure model connections, API keys and plugin access in the host model settings window.
settings.hotkeysDescription: Plugin hotkeys take effect only after you enable them. Click a binding and press a new combination. Escape cancels; Backspace clears it.
settings.appearanceDescription: The theme applies to the shell, built-in views and plugins using shared theme tokens, without reloading.
settings.summonDescription: Summon the main window from anywhere. Click the field and press a combination with Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Super or an F-key. Backspace clears; Escape cancels.
settings.messageDescription: Registered communication schemes. The hub chooses a transport and codec from the plugin declaration.
settings.externalDescription: Place plugin.json and a single-file ESM entry in a plugin folder, then rescan. Changed plugins reload and deleted plugins unload without restarting.
settings.pluginsDescription: Enable or disable an installed plugin. Disabling releases its listeners, streams and DOM.
settings.title: Settings
settings.autostartUnknown: Could not read the autostart state
settings.autostartOff: Does not start with the system
settings.noHotkeys: No plugin has declared a hotkey.
settings.summonUnbound: not bound — the tray icon still opens the window
settings.nothingRunning: Nothing running. A live sidecar, stream or pty appears here, whichever transport opened it.
settings.installed: No plugins installed | {count} plugin installed | {count} plugins installed
settings.modifierRequired: needs a modifier, or an F-key
settings.pluginNotLoaded: Plugin not loaded yet — use Rescan first
settings.autostartEnabled: Toolkit will start with the system
settings.languageDescription: Choose an interface language or follow the system. Open host windows update without restarting plugins.
